csv_project_name: PDS for US 231 Bloomfield W Intersection Improvement
csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Indiana , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to Provide Project Development Services forPavement Replacement on US 231, an intersection improvement on US 50, a small structure replacement on SR 157, a small pipe project on US 50 and two bridge painting projects on US 50. These projects are in Greene, Lawrence, and Martin Counties. It includes R-46724 (2600654 {Lead} and 2600535) and R-46840 (2600704 {Lead}, 2600704, 2600349, and 2600350. The selected firm will perform the design and plan development work necessary to produce the construction contract documents, and provide services including Environmental Services, Ecological Survey, Applicable Permits, Topographic Survey Data Collection, Road Design, Bridge Design, Lighting Design, Utility coordination, RW Plan Development, Title Research, and Construction Phase services. INDOT will provide Real Estate Services, Railroad Coordination, and Geotechnical engineering. INDOT will provide pavement design for Des 2600672 and Des 2600654, consultant will provide pavement design for other Des included in this item if non-standard. 1) US 231, Pavement Replacement, From 0.67 mi. W. Jct. SR 54/SR157 (Bloomfield W. CL) to bridge 1.72 mi W SR 54/SR 157, in Greene Co 2) SR 157, Small Structure Replacement, SR 157, 3+77 MI N OF JCT US231, in Greene Co 3 ) US 50, Other Intersection Improvement, FROM 0.90 miles S of US50 TO 1.22 miles S of US50 (29th St.), in Martin Co 4) US 50, Bridge Painting, US 50 EB, 00.81 W SR 37, in Lawrence Co
